title: Tamanna's two chocolates
description: Two brown chocolate bars sit side by side against a plain white background. On the left is a square chocolate bar made of four identical square blocks arranged in two rows of two, labelled underneath as "Small chocolate". On the right is a larger square chocolate bar made of nine identical blocks of the same size, arranged in three rows of three, labelled underneath as "Big chocolate". Each block has raised, bevelled edges like a piece of chocolate. There are thirteen blocks in total across the two bars, with none broken, missing, or singled out.

title: Half of which roti
description: A vertical grey line divides the view into two panels labelled "Different sizes" and "Same size". In the left panel, a small roti divided into ten equal wedges has five blue wedges on its right half, labelled "Small roti" and "1/2 = 5 pieces". Beside it, a larger roti divided into sixteen equal wedges has eight orange wedges on its right half, labelled "Big roti" and "1/2 = 8 pieces". In the right panel, two equal-sized rotis are each divided into twelve equal wedges. The first has six blue wedges on its right half, labelled "1/2 = 6 pieces". The second has three orange wedges in its top-right...

title: One group of the grid
description: Under the heading "A grid of 21 squares", two side-by-side grids each contain 3 columns and 7 rows, making 21 equal squares in each grid. In the left grid, thick vertical lines separate the 3 columns, and the entire left column of 7 squares is shaded blue, while the remaining 14 squares are white. Below it, the label reads "1/3 = 7 squares". In the right grid, thick horizontal lines separate the 7 rows, and the top row of 3 squares is shaded yellow, while the remaining 18 squares are white. Below it, the label reads "1/7 = 3 squares".

title: Small squares that join
labels: Each square is 1/24 of the grid
description: Centred at the top, text reads "Each square is 1/24 of the grid". Below, two identical grids each have six columns and four rows, making twenty-four equal squares. On the left grid, thick lines divide the twenty-four squares into eight groups of three; the top-left three squares are shaded blue and the other twenty-one are white. Below it reads "3/24 = 1/8" and "3 squares". On the right grid, thick lines divide the squares into twelve groups of two; the top-left two squares are shaded amber and the other twenty-two are white. Below it reads "2/24 = 1/12" and "2 squares".

title: Pieces that fill the circle
description: Two circles appear side by side. On the left, a blue circle is divided into four equal quadrant pieces, each labeled with the fraction "1/4" in white text. Beneath this circle, the text reads "4 pieces of 1/4" above the equation "4/4 = 1 whole". On the right, an amber circle is divided into eight equal wedge-shaped pieces, each labeled with the fraction "1/8" in dark text. Directly below this circle, the text reads "8 pieces of 1/8" above the equation "8/8 = 1 whole".

title: Pieces of different sizes
description: On the left, a circle is divided into four pieces: a blue half on the left labelled "1/2", an amber quarter at the top right labelled "1/4", and two pink eighths at the bottom right, each labelled "1/8". Directly beneath the circle sits the equation "1/2 + 1/4 + 1/8 + 1/8 = 1". A grey horizontal arrow points rightward to an enlarged pink wedge with its vertex pointing downward. A line divides this wedge into two equal parts, each labelled "1/16". Below the wedge is the equation "1/8 = 2/16".

title: Pieces of one twentieth
labels: Each part of the strip is 1/20
description: At the top, printed text reads "Each part of the strip is 1/20". Below it sits a horizontal strip of twenty equal parts, partitioned by thicker lines into four groups of five parts; the first five parts on the left are shaded blue and fifteen remain white. Centred beneath this strip are "1/4 = 5/20" and "5 pieces of 1/20". Further down, a second horizontal strip of twenty equal parts is partitioned by thicker lines into ten pairs of two parts; the first two parts on the left are shaded amber and eighteen remain white. Centred beneath this strip are "1/10 = 2/20" and "2 pieces of 1/20".

title: Cut every part in two
labels: Cut every part into 2 equal pieces
description: Two horizontal bars of equal length are arranged vertically. The upper bar is divided into five equal parts, with the first four parts shaded purple and the fifth part unshaded white. To its right is the fraction '4/5'. A downward arrow between the bars points toward the lower bar, alongside the text 'Cut every part into 2 equal pieces'. The lower bar is divided into ten equal parts, with the first eight shaded purple and the last two unshaded white. To its right is the fraction '8/10'. Centred below both bars is the equation '4/5 = 8/10'.

title: Both numbers times the same
description: Three horizontal bars of equal length are stacked vertically. The top bar is divided into 8 equal parts, with 3 shaded pink and 5 white, labelled "3/8" to its right. The middle bar is divided into 16 equal parts, with 6 shaded pink and 10 white, labelled "6/16". The bottom bar is divided into 24 equal parts, with 9 shaded pink and 15 white, labelled "9/24". All three bars share the same shaded length. Blue arrows connect "3/8" to "6/16" labelled "×2" and "3/8" to "9/24" labelled "×3". Across the bottom sits "3/8 = 6/16 = 9/24".

title: Same size pieces, more pieces
description: Two horizontal bars of equal size are arranged one above the other. The top bar is labeled "Tamanna" above its left edge and is divided into ten equal rectangular sections, with the first three sections shaded blue and the remaining seven unshaded white. To its right is the fraction "3/10". The bottom bar is labeled "Gurpreet" above its left edge and is divided into ten equal rectangular sections, with the first seven sections shaded amber and the remaining three unshaded white. To its right is the fraction "7/10". Centered below both bars is the inequality "7/10 > 3/10".

title: Three pieces each, different sizes
description: Two round parathas of equal size sit side by side. Above the left paratha is the name Radhika. This paratha is divided into 4 equal quarters, with 3 quarters shaded teal and outlined in blue, and 1 quarter unshaded. Underneath are the fraction 3/4 and the label 4 pieces. Above the right paratha is the name Raman. This paratha is divided into 10 equal wedges, with 3 adjacent wedges shaded amber and outlined in orange, and 7 wedges unshaded. Underneath are the fraction 3/10 and the label 10 pieces. Centred below both parathas is the comparison 3/4 > 3/10.

title: Nine halves of a paratha
description: At the top, text reads "Baba took 9 pieces of 1/2 paratha". Below, four whole circular parathas with golden-brown texture and blue borders are each cut vertically into two equal halves, grouped by a bracket labelled "4 whole parathas". Beside them, one pink semicircular piece is labelled "1/2 left over". Below, a number line marked from "0" to "5" has half-unit ticks. Eight blue curved arrows jump by halves from "0" to "4", and a ninth pink arrow labelled "9/2" hops to a pink dot at 4 1/2. Centred at the bottom, an equation states "9/2 = 4 1/2".

title: Eleven fourths and eight thirds
description: Two bands are separated by a grey horizontal line. In the top band, labels read "11 pieces of 1/4 paratha" and "11/4 = 2 3/4". A number line from "0" to "3" is divided into fourths. Eleven curved hops begin at 0: eight blue hops reach 2, and three pink hops land on a pink dot labeled "11/4". In the bottom band, labels read "8 slices of 1/3 pizza" and "8/3 = 2 2/3". Two whole pizzas cut into three equal slices each are bracketed as "2 whole pizzas", beside a third pizza showing two reddish slices labeled "2 slices left over" and a dashed outline for the missing slice.

title: More than, less than or equal to one
description: Three horizontal rows compare fractions to one whole. In the first row, "8/5" and "more than 1" appear beside two bars: one of 5 blue fifths under a bracket labeled "1 whole", and another with 3 pink fifths and 2 white fifths, followed by "= 1 3/5". In the second row, "3/10" and "less than 1" sit beside a bar of 10 tenths under a bracket labeled "1 whole", with 3 pieces shaded blue and 7 white. In the third row, "10/10" and "equal to 1" sit beside a bar of 10 tenths under a bracket labeled "1 whole", with all 10 pieces shaded blue.

title: On either side of one
description: A horizontal number line marked with three vertical ticks labeled "0", "1", and "2", with the tick at "1" highlighted in reddish purple. Two dots sit on the line: a blue dot between "0" and "1" labeled with the fraction "3/5" above it, and an amber dot just to the right of "1" labeled with the fraction "10/9" above it. Below the number line, a blue arrow points left toward "0" labeled "less than 1", and an amber arrow points right toward "2" labeled "more than 1". Centered at the bottom is the statement "3/5 < 10/9".

title: Half line through two circles
description: Two circular diagrams labeled (a) and (b) sit side by side. Circle (a) is divided into 18 equal wedges, with 9 wedges shaded blue on the right and 9 unshaded on the left. A vertical purple line labeled "half line" passes through the center along the dividing boundary. Below are "9 of 18 pieces" and "9/18 = 1/2". Circle (b) has 15 equal wedges, with 7 shaded amber and 8 unshaded. A vertical purple line labeled "half line" cuts through the unshaded eighth wedge, showing the shaded region falls short of half. Below are "7 of 15 pieces" and "7/15 < 1/2".

title: On either side of one half
description: A horizontal number line marked with three vertical ticks labeled '0', '1/2', and '1' underneath. The middle tick at '1/2' is taller and colored reddish-purple. A blue dot sits just to the left of '1/2' with the fraction '5/12' printed above it. An amber dot sits between '1/2' and '1' with '7/10' printed above it. Below the number line, a blue arrow points left toward zero above the label 'less than 1/2', and an amber arrow points right toward one above the label 'more than 1/2'. Centered at the bottom is the inequality '5/12 < 7/10'.

title: Mother, her sister, her daughter
description: Four rounded rectangular boxes are arranged in two rows of two. In the top row, a white box labeled "Your mother" connects via a horizontal blue arrow labeled "link 1" pointing to a white box labeled "Her only sister" with "(your aunt)" beneath it. From that box, a vertical amber arrow labeled "link 2" points down to a white box labeled "Her daughter" in the bottom row. On the bottom left, a purple-pink box labeled "You" is joined to "Your mother" above by a vertical grey line, and connects to "Her daughter" across a horizontal dashed pink line labeled "cousin sister".

title: The kitchen of fractions
description: Nine rectangular cards are arranged in three rows of three using blue and amber fills. Row one shows 'Same whole' with two squares, 'Fraction of a grid' with six blue squares in a 48-square grid, and 'Pieces make a whole' combining parts into '1/2 + 1/4 + 1/4 = 1'. Row two compares bars: 'Equivalent fractions' with '1/3 = 2/6', 'Same denominator' with '2/3 > 1/3', and 'Same numerator' with '4/5 > 4/6'. Row three includes number lines for 'Greater than 1' showing '5/2 = 2 1/2' and 'Compare with 1 and 1/2' showing '7/8 < 8/6', and 'Relations' connecting three family boxes.
